properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 1 at 12:36PM EDT until August 1 at 3:45PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
FFWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northern Gadsden County in Big Bend Florida...
East Central Jackson County in the panhandle of Florida...
Southern Decatur County in southwestern Georgia...
Southwestern Grady County in southwestern Georgia...
Southeastern Seminole County in southwestern Georgia...

* Until 345 PM EDT /245 PM CDT/.

* At 1236 PM EDT /1136 AM CDT/, Doppler radar and automated rain
gauges indicated thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the
warned area. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain have fallen. The
expected rainfall rate is 2 to 3 inches in 1 hour. Flash flooding
is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tallahassee, Quincy, Havana, Chattahoochee, Sneads, Gretna,
Attapulgus, Faceville, Mount Pleasant, Recovery, Fowlstown,
Douglas City, Hardaway, Dogtown, Quincy Airport, Laingkat, Santa
Clara, Branchville, Rosedale and Littman.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
properties.area: Gadsden, FL; Jackson, FL; Decatur, GA; Grady, GA; Seminole, GA
